# Copilot Repository Instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root for project-wide instructions.

Task-specific behavior lives in `ai/workflows/*.md` and `ai/skills/*.md` where a topic is skill-backed. The files under `.github/instructions/*.md` are thin auto-discovery wrappers that point Copilot to those canonical files for wiki maintenance, testing quality, architecture-sensitive work, CI validation, interview questions, user-flow docs, HTTP testing, and code review.
